recipe.visualDefinition: A structured 1960s-style layout featuring a large, horizontally banded typographic header and a series of six vertical, rounded-corner photographic panels arranged in a row against a solid olive-brown background.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal typographic block versus vertical photographic strips
High-contrast black blocks integrated with text
Earth-tone background unifying diverse photographic colors
coreInvariants: Black geometric blocks framing the text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Six full-body portraits occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled equally. The text occupies the top third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central white typographic band containing the primary title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Horizontal scan across the text, followed by a rhythmic left-to-right scan of the six vertical image panels.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial olive-brown margins at the top, bottom, and between the modular elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Olive-brown (Hex #6B5E34) as the primary background and border.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White and Black for the typographic blocks and internal photo backgrounds.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Acid green/yellow for secondary text highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, earthy background contrasting with high-value white text blocks and saturated 60s fashion colors in photos.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Tri-level hierarchy using color and scale within the same font family or style.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century technical aesthetic and width.
Modern equivalent with the correct geometric structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid olive-brown canvas. Place six vertical, rounded-corner white rectangles in a row across the center. Inside each rectangle, place a full-body portrait of people in 1960s fashion against a white background. Add black horizontal bars at the top to frame the future text area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of ultra-extended sans-serif text in the top section. The top line in acid green, the middle (largest) line in white over a black bar, and the bottom line in black.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly six vertical panels?
Is the background a consistent olive-brown?
Is the text ultra-extended and heavy?
Do the panels have rounded corners?

mustRedesign: Original band name and song titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly centered within its respective blocks.
Check that the olive-brown color is flat and matte.
Verify the 1960s fashion style in the photographic elements.
Confirm the aspect ratio of the vertical strips is consistent.
recipe.reuseFormula: Modular vertical strips + horizontal typographic header + olive-brown field = 60s Pop Aesthetic.
